knimeNode.name: Spark Edit Column (Obzen)
knimeNode.shortDescription: Renames, changes types, and reorders columns in a Spark DataFrame.

intro.p: Edits columns in a Spark DataFrame. All input columns are displayed in a table where you can rename, change types, and reorder them using drag-and-drop or Up/Down buttons.

ul.li: Rename: Enter a new name in the "New Name" column. Leave empty to keep the original name.
Type change: Select a new type from the "New Type" dropdown. Supported types: String, Integer, Long, Double, Float, Boolean, Date, Timestamp. Note: Float is mapped to Double in KNIME.
Reorder: Drag rows or use the Up/Down buttons to control output column order.

tab.name: Column Editing
tab.option: The original column name from the input DataFrame (read-only).
The new name for this column. Leave empty to keep the original name.
The original data type of the column (read-only).
The target data type for type casting. Select "(keep)" to keep the original type.
Drag rows or use Up/Down buttons to change the output column order.
Resets all edits (names, types, and order) back to original values.
